unit: US middle and high school students and NYTS
evidence: FDA 2025 NYTS reports 5.2 percent or 1.44 million students currently used e-cigarettes and declines from 2022 to 2025
last_unobserved_stage: causality dependence mental health subgroup persistence and long-term outcome
conversion_question: Does declining prevalence become durable reduced nicotine dependence?

unit: US middle and high school students and CDC/FDA
evidence: 2024 NYTS says e-cigarettes remained the most commonly used youth tobacco product and calls for sustained regulation and enforcement
last_unobserved_stage: policy effectiveness cessation informal supply and adult trade-off
conversion_question: Can regulation prevent youth use while supporting adult cessation?

unit: US youth who use e-cigarettes and product flavors
evidence: CDC reports 88.2 percent of high-school and 85.7 percent of middle-school e-cigarette users used flavored products in 2024
last_unobserved_stage: restriction effect substitution adult cessation and dependence
conversion_question: Do flavor controls reduce initiation without harmful substitution?

unit: US public high-school students rural/urban sex race and ethnicity
evidence: 2025 YRBS reports 16.0 percent current electronic-vapor-product use with higher rural than city prevalence and demographic variation
last_unobserved_stage: comparability causes intervention and product detail
conversion_question: Can tobacco control reduce geographic and demographic exposure gaps?

unit: US FDA CBP warehouses flavored disposables and enforcement operations
evidence: FDA reports seizure of more than 628000 unauthorized products valued above 7 million dollars and ongoing enforcement
last_unobserved_stage: market displacement volume substitution health effect and deterrence
conversion_question: Can enforcement reduce unauthorized exposure rather than reroute supply?

unit: US youth users disposables pods tanks and FDA guidance
evidence: FDA guidance prioritizes unauthorized products and notes disposables were most common among youth users while some users were unsure of device type
last_unobserved_stage: availability compliance illicit adaptation and cessation
conversion_question: Can product-level enforcement track a rapidly changing market?

unit: US middle/high school students NYTS and CDC analysis
evidence: CDC examines association between e-cigarette use and depression/anxiety symptoms and recommends integrating mental-health support while noting cross-sectional limits
last_unobserved_stage: causal direction treatment effectiveness recovery and mechanism
conversion_question: Can mental-health support improve cessation and reduce nicotine harm?

unit: WHO European Region countries and national regulators
evidence: WHO review calls for comprehensive monitored regulation and notes varied national approaches including a 2025 Uzbekistan ban
last_unobserved_stage: cross-country causal comparison enforcement adult harm reduction and market response
conversion_question: Can different regulatory models protect youth and preserve accountable adult choice?
